1.title: BusControl QR
1.description: Mobile app for school attendance control in municipal transport. QR scanning, manual registration, round trips, and real-time traceability with Supabase.
1.motivation: School municipal transport often tracks attendance by hand—slow and easy to lose. I wanted an app to log boardings with QR (plus manual fallback), support round trips, and keep a reliable real-time history for route coordinators.
1.overview: BusControl QR is a mobile app (Expo / React Native) backed by Supabase. Staff can scan codes, fall back to manual entry, and follow each trip without paper sheets.
1.approach: Expo for fast mobile iteration; Supabase for data and auth without a custom backend. Focus stayed on the real attendance flow, not extra features.
learnings: Modeling trips and attendance in real time
Prioritizing manual fallback when QR fails
Keeping ops flow separate from history
